clock: UTC monotonic application clock for movement; wall-clock UTC for retained timestamps
idempotency: Identical valid content for a retained request_id returns the original receipt and status without another state change; different content returns 409.
serialization: Validate and accept requests one at a time in server acceptance order; at most one transfer is active.
observations: Record the pre-movement sample, every elapsed whole second, and the exact terminal sample once. Use 0.1 L resolution and no noise.
persistence: Load initial_state once when preparing the environment. Thereafter retain state, requests, and observations in live_directory.
